      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "retaining block stats from before a failed mempool reload can allow an unready mempool to pass health checks and return inaccurate fee estimates",

    },

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "returning an error on LOW_COVERAGE rather than falling back to block policy leaves callers without an estimate despite block policy being valid",
      "quote": "Should `LOW_COVERAGE` also fall back to the block-policy estimate in combined mode? It tells us that we shouldn't use the **mempool** to lower the estimate, but doesn't necessarily invalidate the avai",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed by force-push falling back to block policy",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5682265146"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5682265146",
      "status_by_quote": "Indeed, I force-pushed fb385bfaac...a623083db1 to fix that. The only exception that we return an error is when the mempo"
    },

      "id": "rc:4020656916",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "wrapping util::Unexpected inside helper functions obscures return semantics at call sites and overloading functions across distant files reduces clarity",
      "quote": "Should return `FeeRateEstimationError` directly instead of wrapped in `util::Unexpected`? This makes the callers much clearer IMO",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed in simplified force-push removing the helper",
      "author_replies": [

    },

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "persisting warmup end height could lead to incorrect warmup state across restarts with long downtime",
      "quote": "Why does this need to be persisted? In what case would it make sense for a warmup to start and get interrupted and then continue?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fix pushed to restart warmup when tracked mined-block window is empty",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4036669492",

      ],

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4030465853",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "failing to fall back to block policy while the mempool is still loading unnecessarily denies an estimate to callers",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted suggestion to fall back to block policy",

        "rc:4035608228"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:4035608228",
      "status_by_quote": "Hmm, yeah, for simplicity, I took your suggestion."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4062417156",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "warmup window could elapse quickly during IBD catch-up and prematurely serve the floor fee while the mempool is still sparse",
      "quote": "is the 144-block warm-up meant to count blocks processed during IBD catch-up? Let's say I was offline for 3 days, I can pass the 144 block window in a few moments when I resume syncing and then return",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed by push skipping warmup and updating stats during IBD catch-up",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4073223563"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4073223563",
      "status_by_quote": "Good catch, I attempted to fix it by adding a new bool to the notification that tells us whether the chainstate is curre"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4075918642",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "accepting saved fee-estimator data that becomes stale during IBD catch-up could degrade estimation accuracy or contribute to IBD slowdown",
      "quote": "this check may accept saved fee-estimator data that becomes stale during IBD catch-up",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "warmup logic was removed completely in the force-push",

        "rc:4083689691"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4083689691",
      "status_by_quote": "So I simplify by disallowing the fee rate return flow completely; this is simpler and should handle the most important l"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4077866617",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "returning an error when the block-policy estimator has no result denies callers a fee estimate even when the mempool estimator could provide one",
      "quote": "if the block-policy estimator has no result, this returns an error even when the mempool estimator can provide a fee rate",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained rationale and reviewer accepted",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4083688625"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4083688625",
      "status_by_quote": "This is the desired behaviour, it's a belt-and-suspenders on `mempool_policy` fee rate estimator"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4088236014",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "falling back to block policy instead of returning a floored estimate when a healthy mempool has fewer transactions than the target percentile prevents mempool estimation when the mempool is legitimately low, such as on test networks or quiet periods",
      "quote": "In the case of a node with a healthy view of the mempool, but a mempool that has less than a p50 or p75 of transactions, don't we actually want to return the floored estimate instead of falling back t",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "davidgumberg pushed back, arguing the PR should drop the last two commits rather than overestimate fees when the mempool is starved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4091891712"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4096852515",
      "status_by_quote": "I'm not sure I agree, I think it would be better to drop the last two commits entirely from this PR"
    }
  ],
